verdict.rationale: BILL publishes an official Postman collection for the v3 API that can be forked from the Postman API Network. That is a machine-readable API description, but it is not a downloadable OpenAPI file. The llms.txt index and markdown docs are AI-friendly documentation rather than an API spec, so they are not credited here. missing for 10: an explicitly downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger spec file, documentation of the spec's coverage of Spend & Expense endpoints, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Simply fork the collection from the Postman API Network and begin testing with different BILL v3 API workflows.
